Ben / Sofia -

Thanks. A few clarifying questions before the technical call:
- Data residency: can Redwood guarantee EU/US region isolation per dataset? We need region-specific controls for some customer data.
- Retention: can you provide a sample data retention policy and confirm whether retention can be set per-tenant?
- Audit logs: will the sample logs include identity fields redacted but show access/authorization events and timestamps? We also need to confirm whether logs support subject access request workflows.
- SOC2 / Pen test: redacted reports are fine. Will you share dates of the audit and the scope (production infra vs. limited environment)?

If you can include short answers to the above in the link you share, that will help our procurement/legal review.

Regards,
Raj Patel
CISO | Quantix
raj.patel@quantix.io

Hi all -

Per our plan, we've uploaded the initial batch of artifacts to a secure Box folder. Links and short answers below. Please let us know if you need fuller versions (we can provide on NDA/DocuSign as required).

Links / artifacts:
- SOC2 (redacted): SOC2_TypeII_report_redacted.pdf (attestation date: 2026-03-15; scope: production infra + control environment)
- Pen test summary: pen_test_summary.pdf (most recent test: 2026-02; high/med/low findings summarized)
- Audit logs sample: audit_logs_sample.csv (identity fields redacted; includes auth, token issuance, API access, timestamped events)
- Evidence checklist: redwood-security-evidence-checklist.pdf

Box link (secure): https://redwood.box.com/s/quantix-security-evidence
HubSpot record: HS-234512
DocuSign (if you want to move to NDA): DocuSign:DOC-98765

Short answers to Raj's questions:
- Data residency: Yes - we support region-specific deployments. Data can be isolated by tenant in US and EU regions.
- Retention: Retention can be configured per-tenant; our default retention policies are documented in the retention appendix (see checklist).
- Audit logs: Sample logs include access/authorization events with timestamps; identity attributes are redacted in the sample but full logs (sensitive fields masked) can be provided under an NDA and with log access agreements. We support SAR workflows via API for account owners.
- SOC2/Pen test scope & dates: See file headers - SOC2 attestation 2026-03-15 (Type II), pen test summary dated 2026-02-12 covering production-ish test scope; full report available under standard exchange process.

Attachments in Box: SOC2_TypeII_report_redacted.pdf, pen_test_summary.pdf, audit_logs_sample.csv

Next steps:
- Please confirm receipt and whether the artifacts satisfy legal/security gate checks.
- If procurement wants contract redlines, Emily - please share your template and target clauses (PO terms, indemnity, data processing addendum).
- Schedule: proposed procurement/technical follow-up call Tue 6/23 2:00pm PT.

Thanks -
